entities.name: Bozak
entities.description: A kraul with a malformed wing who wins an apprenticeship under a lich, later swallows a poisonous mushroom and leaps from the Hanging Keep to protect Vraska, and ends up fungus-controlled by Mazirek.

entities.name: Razi
entities.description: Bozak's sister, the best singer in the family, who urges him not to leave the farmstead.

entities.name: Mother
entities.description: The giant beetle whose carapace shelters Bozak's family of 107 kraul siblings; her mind was compromised by invaders.

entities.name: Kuurik
entities.description: A sibling who taught Bozak about mushrooms.

entities.name: Ellin
entities.description: A sibling who is the best flier in the family.

entities.name: Limin
entities.description: A kraul with gossamer wings raised in the undercity who allies with Bozak, then betrays him by waking mossdogs.

entities.name: Kata
entities.description: A young olive-green gorgon competitor who petrifies mossdogs and Bozak's locusts before Bozak stabs her.

entities.name: Zegodonis
entities.description: A gaudy Devkarin elf competitor who survives a woodwraith attack and also wins an apprenticeship under the lich.

entities.name: The Lich
entities.description: A newly named Devkarin elf lich who holds the apprenticeship contest and secretly plots with Boros soldiers to frame Vraska for the Tin Street massacre.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: The gorgon planeswalker and Golgari guildmaster, whom Bozak saves from being implicated in a plot.

entities.name: Mazirek
entities.description: A kraul priest and advisor to Vraska whom Bozak admires and who ends up controlling Bozak's fungus-riddled body.

entities.name: Benzi
entities.description: A fungal drudge zombie whom Bozak tends and names.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of rot and the undercity, led by Vraska.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose officers collude with the lich and were poisoned with zombie fungus at Sunhome.

entities.name: Krunstraz
entities.description: The crowd of Golgari followers Vraska addresses at the Hanging Keep.

entities.name: Devkarin
entities.description: The elf clan of the Swarm, from which liches and Zegodonis come.

entities.name: Hanging Keep
entities.description: A kraul fortress clinging to the undercity ceiling where Vraska addresses followers.

entities.name: Korozda
entities.description: The Golgari guildhall where the liches confer.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros guildhall where officers were exposed to zombie fungus.

entities.name: Tin Street Massacre
entities.description: A massacre caused by devouring angel spores, for which Gruul raiders were arrested; the lich plans to pin it on Vraska.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story is set.

events.summary: Bozak, harvesting rare mushrooms on the family farmstead, hears the undercity news that a new lich seeks an apprentice skilled at mushroom identification.
events.quote: the lich is seeking an apprentice with a proficiency in mushroom identification and a keen interest in necromancy.

events.summary: Bozak explains why he wants to be a necromancer and sneaks away from his siblings and Mother's carapace to enter the contest.
events.quote: I pack my maps, my journals, my vials, and my harvester's satchel and sneak away while my siblings lie dreaming.

events.summary: The lich starts a contest for twenty-six competitors to retrieve four of the most dangerous mushrooms in Ravnica, handing out maps.
events.quote: Only one of you will be deemed skillful enough to serve as my apprentice,

events.summary: Zegodonis bumps Bozak and tears his map; Bozak then spots woodwraiths in the mangrove and warns a few others, who escape while the rest are killed.
events.quote: We hear the creaking of old branches and the suck of roots pulling up from waterlogged soil.

events.summary: Bozak meets the kraul Limin and the gorgon Kata, collects zombie fungus, and makes a temporary truce with Limin.
events.quote: If we share information and resources, we can all but guarantee a kraul will win.

events.summary: An elf competitor punctures his zombie fungus, is overtaken by spores and climbs a tree to die as a host.
events.quote: The elf chooses a tree and scales it like his body had been built for this sole purpose.

events.summary: Bozak collects devouring angel mushrooms from a mossdog den while Limin spreads his scent; Limin throws a rock and wakes the dogs and flies off.
events.quote: tossing a rock into the mossdog den

events.summary: Bozak and Kata team up against the mossdogs; Kata petrifies them but also kills nearly a hundred of Bozak's locusts.
events.quote: The third mossdog turns into a statue, and with it, nearly a hundred locusts.

events.summary: Kata tries to petrify Bozak, and he stabs her in the stomach with his staff carved from Mother's leg.
events.quote: I move fast, thrust the staff forward. It catches the gorgon in the stomach.

events.summary: Riding a deadbridge goliath, Bozak races back while the surviving Zegodonis ambushes Limin and steals his satchel; Bozak reaches the lich first.
events.quote: He batters Limin as he passes, breaking off two legs and part of a wing.

events.summary: The lich declares both Bozak and Zegodonis his apprentices, though he favors Zegodonis.
events.quote: And both of you shall serve under me.

events.summary: Months later Bozak tends zombies and learns that Boros officers have been exposed to zombie fungus, and Vraska fears Boros will use it to infiltrate the undercity.
events.quote: Three high-ranking Boros officers were exposed to the same type of zombie fungus we had been asked to gather.

events.summary: Alone in the lich's sanctum, Bozak tries a death spell for the first time on a rat corpse.
events.quote: I practice the movements I've seen the lich do

events.summary: Hiding in a nook, Bozak overhears the lich telling Boros soldiers that he planted a devouring angel mushroom on Vraska's gown to frame her for the Tin Street massacre.
events.quote: Boros will have no choice but to charge Vraska with murder.

events.summary: The lich reveals he hopes Boros will back a Devkarin successor as guildmaster, and the soldiers hint Zegodonis is their pick.
events.quote: they take into consideration the help I've been to you today.

events.summary: Bozak reanimates the rat for the first time and uses it to bite the lich, creating a distraction so he can flee to warn Vraska.
events.quote: then takes a chomp on the lich's ankle.

events.summary: Bozak reaches the Hanging Keep and consumes zombie fungus to lose his fear and climb seven stories to Vraska.
events.quote: I pull a zombie fungus sample from my satchel and place it on my tongue.

events.summary: Mazirek orders Bozak thrown out; Bozak tears his own arm free, swallows the devouring angel mushroom from Vraska's gown and leaps from the Keep.
events.quote: I grab the devouring angel mushroom on her gown and swallow it whole.

events.summary: Bozak survives the fall but wakes controlled by the fungus, with Mazirek tending him, and willingly submits to serve him.
events.quote: ready and willing to serve him as best I can

relations.quote: And both of you shall serve under me.

relations.note: Plots to frame her for the massacre.
relations.quote: Boros will have no choice but to charge Vraska with murder.
Vraska, our guildmaster, is worried the Boros will use this as another excuse to infiltrate the undercity
Her guards and advisors are with her

relations.note: Fungal control leaves him bound to Mazirek.
relations.quote: I'm looking at him how the fungus drudges look at me, eagerly awaiting his command.

relations.note: He stabs her in their fight.
relations.quote: Only one can win, Bozak. And it's going to be me.
